_comment: cannot just read the server's quiet_now: the settings GET is not polled
and the overlay is pinned no-poll, so a boolean fetched at boot is wrong
an hour later -- precisely at the boundary this setting exists to honour.
So the rule is written twice, and this file is the single table both
lanes run VERBATIM so the two cannot drift apart silently.
Adding a case here adds it to both lanes at once. That is the point --
do not inline a case in one lane.

active.why: no window set is never quiet, at any hour
same-day window: one minute before the start
EXACTLY AT START is quiet -- the interval is inclusive there
same-day window: the last quiet minute
EXACTLY AT END is NOT quiet -- half-open, 'quiet until 17:00'
a same-day window must not leak across midnight
wrap window: one minute before the start
wrap window: the last minute before midnight
WRAPS MIDNIGHT -- the case a naive start<=t<end gets wrong
wrap window: the small hours, the whole point of the setting
wrap window: the last quiet minute
wrap window: exactly at end is not quiet
wrap window: the middle of the gap
a one-minute window at midnight is still a window
and it ends where it says it does

invalid.why: start == end has two honest readings and no way to pick one
same at midnight -- a whole day and no time at all look alike
not zero-padded -- input type=time never emits this
null is how the WHOLE window is cleared, not one end of it
numbers are not times of day
a string is not a window
a list is not a window
a boolean is not a window
